$comment: Android App Links: which signing certificates may open links on each site. Read by scripts/app-links-plugin.js, which emits /.well-known/assetlinks.json for the host in VITE_SITE_URL. Fingerprints are public certificate hashes, not secrets. Each environment lists only its own build: dev.meetifyy.app the debug key that signs development APKs; meetifyy.app the release (and Play app-signing) key once it is approved. An empty list emits nothing, so links open in the browser.
